The '''Trade Conflicts''' is a name that was collectively given to a series of conflicts that were fought between the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daimar]] and surrounding [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] worlds during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
Daimar was positioned on a key point on a trade route through the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], causing its Rodian neighbors to resent it, as they believed that it was taking money away from them. This led to the break out of the Trade Conflicts between them, the first of which occurred in about [[69 BBY/Legends|69 BBY]].<ref name="FOR">"[[Flames of Rebellion]]" claims that the conflicts began 50 years before the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which occurred in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]</ref> The conflicts varied from border skirmishes to full out wars. [[Alet Komain]] fought for Daimar during the conflicts and rose through the ranks, to eventually become a distinguished military commander.
